sections.shortTitle: Opium Extension to the N -W F P Act 1952
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE OPIUM (EXTENSION TO THE NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER) ACT, 1952
THE OPIUM
(EXTENSION TO THE NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER) ACT, 1952.
ACT No. XL of 1952
[9th December,
1952]
An Act to extend the Opium Act, 1857, to the North‑West Frontier (The original word "Province" omitted ibid. (with
effect from the 14th October, 1955).)*
1. Short title and
commencement---‑(1) This Act may be called the Opium (Extension to
the North‑West Frontier (The original word
"Province" omitted ibid. (with effect from the 14th
October, 1955).)*) Act, 1952.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
